description.fallback: Naruto pleaded with Amaru to ignore the darkness in her heart, which finally resulted in the beast being defeated. Sakura woke up in Naruto's arms, and slapped him to fill the awkward moment. They decided to split up, with Naruto continuing to search for the villagers and Hinata and Sakura returning to Konoha to get help.

outro.fallback: Shinnō had fused with the cocoon, and attacked Naruto and Sasuke.
All of their counterattacks proved useless, as any chakra they used was absorbed by the cocoon and rendered harmless.
